## What changed

One paragraph: the user-visible or developer-visible outcome, not the file
tour.

## Why

Link the issue this closes (`Closes #123`) or explain the motivation.

## How to verify

- [ ] `npm run lint` / `typecheck` / `test` / `build` pass locally
- [ ] Manual testnet steps (if behavior changed): 1)… 2)… 3)…

## Screenshots

For UI changes, before/after. A GIF beats three paragraphs.

## Notes for review

Anything unusual: tradeoffs made, decisions you'd argue the other way on,
places you'd like a second opinion.

---

Small, focused PRs review faster. One issue per PR is the default; if you
bundled, say why below.
